description: This bar chart illustrates the “effect” values for several language families across different BERT models. The horizontal axis represents language families, labeled “Uralic,” “Semitic,” “Isolate,” “IE-other,” “IE-Slavic family,” “IE-Romance,” and “Isolate,” listed in that order from right to left. The vertical axis, labeled “effect,” displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40, with tick marks at intervals of 10. For each language family, there is a grouped set of four bars representing different BERT models: “XLM-R₂” (light green), “XLM-B₂” (red), “mBERT-B₂” (teal), and “MLM-R₂” (dark green). Each bar is accompanied by a black error bar extending vertically from its top. Within each language family, the bars generally show similar heights, with values ranging approximately from 10 to 25; for example, in the “Uralic” family, the bars range from approximately 11 to 16. No bars are visually emphasized, and the grouping is arranged by language family with each model represented side-by-side.
